subject: Re: Request: short trial extension or production coupon?
body:
---
From: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@novacorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short trial extension or production coupon?

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Novacorp has been running more realistic workloads overnight and we hit a couple of edge cases but generally see strong signal on retrieval and reranking.

We have one blocker: the internal procurement review finishes next Friday, and the evaluation ends on Monday. Our execs want one of two options to avoid losing momentum:

- A brief 10 business day extension on the time-boxed pilot (no charge) so our security and SRE teams finish the final integration tests; OR
- A production-credit coupon (one-time offset) we can apply to the first month after purchase (helps justify the procurement line item).

Budget is tight for Q2 so we need your help to provide something that keeps the initiative moving. Curious which option Redwood typically grants for customers at this stage, and what trade-offs you’d expect from our side.

Appreciate any flexibility — copying Vijay (eng lead) for technical context.

Best,
Alice
Product Lead, Novacorp

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@novacorp.com>
Cc: Vijay Rao <vijay@novacorp.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension or production coupon?

Hi Alice — great to hear the overnight runs were productive.

We can do either path, but each has slightly different approvals and operational implications. Two pragmatic, documented options I can offer today:

Option A — 10 business day trial extension (no additional invoice):
- Redwood provides a 2-week extension to your existing time-boxed pilot.
- We’ll add an engineering milestone: a short integration task list (3 items) that our Solutions team and your SRE jointly validate. This ensures the extension is used for verification not open-ended testing.
- No change to pricing; no PO required. Internal approval: AE + Solutions manager sign-off (I can handle).

Option B — Production coupon (one-time credit):
- Redwood issues a one-time credit equal to 30% of an estimated first-month run rate (capped at $12,000).
- Coupon is applied to the first invoice post-conversion and requires a signed intent-to-purchase within 30 days of pilot end.
- Internal approval required: AE + RevOps + finance — takes slightly longer but supports procurement requests.

If it helps, I can propose a hybrid: 10 business day extension plus a smaller coupon ($5k cap) contingent on signing a short intent letter. That’s defensible to RevOps and keeps engineering time.

I’ve attached a one-page amendment that outlines Option A and the hybrid — if you want Option B I’ll route to finance and legal for the coupon paperwork.

Next steps: tell me which you prefer and I’ll circulate the right docs.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: trial-extension-amendment.pdf (1 page)

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Request: short trial extension or production coupon? — approval request

Steph — quick ask. Novacorp asked for either a 10 business day extension or a production coupon up to $12k. I recommended a hybrid (extension + $5k coupon contingent on an intent-to-purchase).

Impact: if we approve the hybrid, net-first-month revenue may be reduced by up to $5k but it materially increases chance of conversion given procurement timing. Estimated ACV for the opportunity (per HubSpot) is $180k with expected start in Q3.

Can you approve a one-off coupon up to $5k and an engineering milestone requirement on the extension? If you prefer, I can limit coupon to credits applied against hosted API usage only (no credits for professional services).

Thanks — need a quick yes/no to get back to Alice today.

— Marissa

---
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stefanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 12:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Request: short trial extension or production coupon? — approval request

Marissa — OK to approve the hybrid with the following constraints:

1) Cap coupon at $5,000 and restrict to hosted API invoice credit only (no services).
2) Attach the engineering milestone checklist to the extension amendment and require sign-off from Novacorp SRE within the extension window.
3) Include a clause: coupon void if Novacorp does not sign an intent-to-purchase within 30 days of the pilot end. RevOps to track.
4) Finance will need the deal_id (please add NC-2025-0423 in the amendment) and the expected ACV for the Revenue forecast.

David — loop in RevOps/Finance to create the invoice credit flow and confirm accounting treatment. If anything else is required I’ll escalate.

— Steph

---
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alice Zhang <alice.zhang@novacorp.com>
Cc: Vijay Rao <vijay@novacorp.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short trial extension or production coupon?

Hi Alice — quick update and good news.

Steph approved a hybrid concession: Redwood will grant a 10 business day extension plus a one-time hosted-API credit capped at $5,000. A few important details:

- The extension will start the day your current pilot period ends and runs for 10 business days.
- Engineering milestone checklist is required (3 validation items). Your SRE must confirm completion in email to Marissa during the extension window.
- Coupon is issued as a hosted-API invoice credit and is void unless Novacorp signs an intent-to-purchase within 30 days of pilot end. Cap: $5,000. Deal ID: NC-2025-0423.

I attached the amendment for signature (trial-extension-amendment.pdf) and a pricing matrix for your review. If you’re good with the hybrid I’ll send the DocuSign and route the credit to RevOps/Finance.

DocuSign (draft): https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/NDX-9345
HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/NC-2025-0423

Next steps from your side: reply with either “OK — proceed” or suggest which single option you prefer. If OK, I’ll send the DocuSign and copy finance.

Thanks — excited to keep Novacorp moving.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments referenced: trial-extension-amendment.pdf, pricing-matrix.xlsx
